**[8]** "Before You Begin — Self-Hosting." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/self-hosting/before-you-begin/>
**Tier:** 2
Self-hosted deployments run as Docker images. Supported environments: AWS
(Fargate, EC2, ECS, EKS), Azure (Container Service, AKS), GKE, OpenShift,
VMware VMs, Docker Compose on cloud VMs. Requires contacting AE/CSM for
Docker image access.

**[9]** "Custom Deployment — Docker Compose." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/self-hosting/docker-compose/custom-deployment/>
**Tier:** 2
Three core containers: tines-app (Rails web server), tines-sidekiq
(background worker), tines-nginx (SSL termination). Requires PostgreSQL and
Redis. Async task queuing via Redis. No direct container-to-container
communication.

**[10]** "Run Script." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/actions/tools/run-script/>
**Tier:** 2
Python 3.13 only. AWS Lambda execution. 6MB input/output payload limit.
250MB unzipped package limit. 756MB ephemeral storage. Default 10s timeout,
max 110s. Dependencies via requirements.txt as Lambda layers. Must define
`main(input)` function returning JSON.

**[11]** "Command-over-HTTP." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/self-hosting/additional-applications/command-over-http/>
**Tier:** 2
Supports python3, bash, and powershell executors. JSON payload with
`executor` and `script` fields. Target URL: `https://command-over-http/run`.
Requires tunnel add-on for cloud customers; included for self-hosted.
Docker container: `tines/command-over-http:latest`.

Credential types: Text, JWT, OAuth 2.0, AWS, HTTP Request, Mutual TLS,

**[13]** "OAuth Credentials." *Tines Docs*, n.d.

OAuth grant types: client_credentials and authorization_code. Automatic

**[14]** "Database Field-Level Encryption." *Tines Docs*, n.d.

Existing records encrypted via `bundle exec rake tines:encrypt_models`.

**Tier:** 2
Cloud tenants: AWS RDS database. Self-hosted: customer PostgreSQL database.

**[16]** "Webhook Actions." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/actions/types/webhook/>
**Tier:** 2
Auth methods: secret in URL, HMAC-SHA256 signing, OAuth (Team/Tenant scope),
API keys (Bearer/Basic). Rate limiting: configurable key/count/period, 429
on exceed. Custom response: message, code (default 201), headers. Response-
enabled webhooks: 100 concurrent (1000 dedicated), 30s timeout to Exit
action. HTTP methods: configurable comma-separated list.

**[17]** "API Welcome." *Tines API Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/api/welcome/>
**Tier:** 2
REST API: `https://<tenant-domain>/api/v1/<endpoint>`. Auth via X-User-Token
or Bearer token. Pagination: 20 default, max 500 per page. Endpoint
categories: credentials, stories, actions, cases, records, teams, users,
audit logs, admin, dashboards, SCIM.

**[18]** "API Rate Limits." *Tines API Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/api/api-rate-limits/>
**Tier:** 2
Most APIs: 5000 req/min. Specific limits: actions (100), admin/users (500),
audit_logs (1000), records (400), tokens (2500). Enforced per IP + API token.

**[19]** "HTTP Request Action." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/actions/types/http-request/>
**Tier:** 2
Retry with exponential backoff: 5s initial, doubles to 600s cap, jitter up
to `10*(retry_count+1)` seconds. Max 25 retries (~3h20m total). Requires
`retry_on_status` to activate. `emit_failure_event` options: Always, Never,
Error response only (default).

**[20]** "Story Runs." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/stories/story-runs/>
**Tier:** 2
Unique GUID per run (STORY_RUN_GUID function or META.story_run.id). Event
filtering: "Show this run's events only" or "Show this event's path only".
Story Runs panel shows event count, action count, timing. Routes panel
highlights execution path including Explode mode divergence.

Size limits: Event 100MB, Record File 10MB, Page File 20MB, HTTP Request

**[22]** "AI Agent Action." *Tines Docs*, n.d.
<https://www.tines.com/docs/actions/types/ai-agent/>
**Tier:** 2
Two modes: Task (one-shot or autonomous with tools) and Chat (conversational

Internal Tools (Think, Code Analysis). MCP client support: Streamable HTTP,
Plain HTTP transports; OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; tools only (no resources/
prompts/notifications). Temperature 0-1 (default 0.2). Timeout default 30s.
File support: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP/PDF/CSV/MD/TXT/DOC/DOCX/XLS/XLSX, 3 files
per message, 4.5MB each.

**[24]** "MCP Server FAQs." *Tines Explained*, n.d.

MCP server is not an MCP client. Supported clients: Anthropic Claude,

modes: public, secret, team, tenant.
